# Telephote

> Portable phone webcam receiver for Windows 11 x64.

The Windows app is free. Telephote for iPhone costs A$5 AUD once, with no subscriptions; its public phone download is coming soon. The regular Windows release is 0.3.1. Extract the complete ZIP and run Telephote.exe. iPhone USB requires compatible Apple USB hardware support already present on the PC. The app does not install drivers. Wi-Fi requires a reachable local network.

Android support is a separate test release, 0.3.1-android.2, for USB UVC webcams or local MJPEG streams. Physical Android and Android-to-Teams validation remains pending. USB Webcam mode requires no phone companion. Other Android inputs require a compatible camera app; third-party charges may apply. No RTSP, ADB or proprietary DroidCam USB support.

- [Product, pricing and downloads](https://telephote.co/)
- [Android setup and limitations](https://telephote.co/android.html)
- [In-app updates](https://telephote.co/updates.html)
- [Download privacy and retention](https://telephote.co/privacy.html)
